# Text File

## Summary
The FileDef specialization for plain text. An instance is an uploaded realm
file with card semantics: the binary lives at the file URL, the card
carries metadata and renders with document-aware formats.

## Example
```ts
import { TextFileDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/text-file-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(TextFileDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — same fixture pass as the
File renderer specs.
